---
title: "Thesis fun"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(MyFunctions)

pkgs <- c(
  "pdftools",
  "tidyverse",
  "tm",
  "tidytext"
)

MyFunctions::my_lib(pkgs)



```

# Load Thesis

```{r}

thesis <- pdf_text("thesis.pdf")


thesis[3] #
```


# Wrangling

```{r}
rows<-scan(textConnection(thesis), 
           what="character", sep = "\n")


tibble(thesis) %>% 
  unnest_tokens(word, thesis) %>% 
  anti_join(stop_words) %>% 
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  filter(n > 100) %>%
  mutate(word = reorder(word, n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, word)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(y = NULL)




```
